_notes: UQM 0.8.0's own lander picking up mineral nodes, recorded as lander.json is, with the nodes put on the surface as GeneratePlanetSide puts them and CheckObjectCollision's contacts found by UQM's own DrawablesIntersect with the masks of graphics.lander and graphics.miscdata from the official content package (SHA-256 77d75ac25e6fb755a33c4ba3b38a7b7bc41fcbc02896891b0cc9ac9214b72eef). Positions and pickups come from code and the masks' shapes; no content.

Landings on the three worlds with the most mineral nodes and no energy or life (world-surfaces.json's nodes; named world-STAR-PLANET-MOON), landing on the first node, and on nodes packed round the site, with and without the cargo upgrade (4) and firing, and with little storage room left.

input as in lander.json, with storage (the room left in the storage bays) and nodes ([element, density, x, y] on the scan map, by node number). frames as in lander.json: [phase, x, y, facing, offset, crew, seed, moving elements [x, y, life_span, playerNr], nodes left, hold [ElementLevel, BiologicalLevel, ElementAmounts by category], mineral text [NumFrames, amount, baseline x, y], taken [[scan, node]]]. After: the ship's element_amounts, total_element_mass and total_bio_mass.
